title: Overview
text:
Cinematic Zoom Extended 
 Smooth, configurable zoom with two profiles and animated cinema bars. 
  The zoom view needs JavaScript.  
 Hold a key and the view eases in while black bars slide across the screen. Release the key and it eases back out. Two independent profiles, six easing curves, ultra-wide zoom, and snap targets like  2x  or  45fov . It also scales mouse sensitivity, removes view bobbing, and hides the HUD, crosshair, and hands independently. Runs on Fabric, Quilt, Forge, and NeoForge, from 1.20.1 to 26.3. 
 
 A fork of  Cinematic Zoom (Fabric)  by  Mel1x , based on the original  Cinematic Zoom  by  KubePixel . Published with Mel1x's permission ( PR #8 ). Not affiliated with or endorsed by either author. 
 
  CurseForge ↗  GitHub Releases ↗

title: Install
text:
Install 
  Client-side only. Servers don't need it. 
 
 Install  Fabric Loader  (or Quilt Loader),  Fabric API ,  Cloth Config , and  Mod Menu  for your Minecraft version. Cloth Config and Mod Menu are required. 
 Put the jar for your Minecraft version in  mods . 
 Remove any other Cinematic Zoom build. Only one can be installed. 
 
 Choose the jar for your Minecraft version and loader: 
  
 
 
 Loader 
 Minecraft 
 
 
 
 
 Fabric, Quilt 
 1.20.1, 1.21.1, 1.21.2–1.21.4, 1.21.5–1.21.6, 1.21.7–1.21.8, 1.21.9–1.21.11, 26.1–26.1.2, 26.2, 26.3 
 
 
 NeoForge 
 1.20.1, 1.21.1, 1.21.2, 1.21.5, 1.21.7, 1.21.11, 26.1, 26.2, 26.3 
 
 
 Forge 
 1.20.1, 1.21.1, 1.21.5, 1.21.7, 1.21.11, 26.1, 26.2, 26.3 
 
 
  
 Forge published no 1.21.2 loader. 
 Fabric needs Fabric API, Cloth Config, and Mod Menu. NeoForge needs its matching Cloth Config distribution. Forge 1.20.1 needs Cloth Config for Forge; newer Forge uses a built-in settings screen and needs neither Cloth Config nor Mod Menu. Open settings through your loader's mod list. 
 Java requirements: 17 for 1.20.1, 21 for 1.21.x, and 25 for 26.x. Quilt runs the Fabric jar. See  verification  for results and limits. 
 New builds use  cinematic-zoom-extended-<jar>-<loader>-<version>.jar . The published 1.0.0 downloads keep their original  cinematiczoom-extended-<jar>-1.0.0.jar  filenames.

title: Use
text:
Use 
 The view below runs the mod's zoom code over the title-screen panorama. Click it, then use the keys;  Esc  lets go of the mouse. On touch, drag. 
  The zoom view needs JavaScript.  
  
   Key  Does   
 
   C   Cinematic zoom, with bars. Hold, or press once with  Toggle zoom  on.  
   V   Zoom without bars, with its own settings.  
  Wheel  Change magnification while zoomed.  
   ↑   ↓   Bar height, 1% a press (Legacy framing).  
   ←   →   Cycle aspect ratios: Auto, 2.39, 2.35, 2, 1.85, 16:9, 16:10, 4:3, 1:1, Legacy. Wider than the window adds top and bottom bars, narrower adds side bars.  
   
 Rebind under  Controls → Key Binds → Cinematic Zoom . Nothing zooms while a screen such as the inventory is open. 
 Two profiles 
  The zoom view needs JavaScript.  
 Ultra-wide 
 With  Allow ultrawide zoom , the wheel goes past 1× down to 0.5×. 
  The zoom view needs JavaScript.

title: Configure
text:
Configure 
   Mod Menu → Cinematic Zoom Extended → Settings , or your loader's mod list on Forge and NeoForge. The main ones, live, for both profiles: 
  The zoom view needs JavaScript.  
  
 
 
 Setting 
 Default 
 Notes 
 
 
 
 
 Starting zoom 
  3×  in both profiles 
 Each profile keeps its own magnification. 
 
 
 Bar height 
  15%  
 Cinematic profile only; arrow keys adjust it by  1% . 
 
 
 Zoom duration 
  240 ms  in and out 
 Separate values for each profile. 
 
 
 Easing curve 
 Exponential 
 Separate curves for zoom in and out. 
 
 
 Hide HUD, crosshair, hands 
 On 
 Each option is independent in each profile. 
 
 
 Toggle zoom 
 Off 
 Hold the key by default. 
 
 
 Mouse wheel during zoom 
 On 
 Changes magnification while zooming. 
 
 
 Ultra-wide zoom 
 Off 
 Allows zooming out to  0.5×  when enabled. 
 
 
 Snap targets 
 Empty 
 Set targets such as  2x  or  45fov  per profile. 
 
 
  
 Easing curves  Slowed down: 
  The zoom view needs JavaScript.  
 Snap targets   Target values  list zooms ( 2x ) or fields of view ( 45fov ,  45deg ,  45° ). With  Magnetize zoom targets  on, each wheel notch goes to the next one: 
  The zoom view needs JavaScript.  
 Aspect ratios 
 New installations default to accurate magnification up to 500× and independent Linear bar animation. The aspect list includes Auto, 2.39:1, 2.35:1, 2:1, 1.85:1, 16:9, 16:10, 4:3, and 1:1. Add custom ratios or remove and reorder entries to control cycling. Ratios wider than the window add top and bottom bars, and narrower ratios add side bars. This crops the composition with an overlay. It does not change Minecraft's viewport or projection aspect. 
 Left and right cycling works while cinematic zoom is active. Enable global cycling to select a profile outside zoom. The selection is saved. Entry, exit, and profile changes each have their own Instant, Linear, or Smooth mode and duration. Profile changes leave magnification unchanged. Regular zoom always clears bars. 
 Both settings screens expose the maximum magnification, wheel settings, custom ratios, and all profile options. The Forge built-in screen takes comma-separated ratios in cycling order and validates them when saving. 
 Config file 
 Settings are saved to  config/cinematiczoom.json  in your Minecraft folder: 
  
 
 
 OS 
 Path 
 
 
 
 
 Windows 
  %appdata%\.minecraft\config\cinematiczoom.json  
 
 
 macOS 
  ~/Library/Application Support/minecraft/config/cinematiczoom.json  
 
 
 Linux 
  ~/.minecraft/config/cinematiczoom.json  
 
 
  
 Existing configurations keep legacy FOV, percentage bars, and their saved zoom limits. Migration creates  cinematiczoom.json.v1.bak . Invalid files get a separate backup, and a failed backup disables writes to preserve the original. Unknown settings survive saves. Delete the config to start with the new defaults. 
 Coming from another zoom mod 
 On first launch, with no  cinematiczoom.json  yet, Extended imports what it recognizes from: 
 
  Zoomify:   config/zoomify.json  
  Ok Zoomer:   config/ok_zoomer/config.toml  or legacy  okzoomer.json  
  Just Zoom:   config/justzoom/config.json  
  Other zoom mods:  any JSON or TOML file with  zoom  in its path, matched by key name. 
 
 WI Zoom and Logical Zoom keep no config. Delete  cinematiczoom.json  and relaunch to import again. 
 Migrating from Cinematic Zoom 1.3 
 Swap the  cinematiczoom-*.jar  for Extended and keep  config/cinematiczoom.json . These keys carry over:  startingZoom ,  baseZoomMultiplier ,  barsPercent ,  smoothMs ,  hideHudDuringZoom ,  enableCinematicCamera ,  toggleMode ,  minZoomMultiplier .

title: Troubleshooting
text:
Troubleshooting 
  
 
 
 Problem 
 Fix 
 
 
 
 
  requires cloth-config2  
 Install Cloth Config for your Minecraft version. 
 
 
  requires modmenu  
 Install Mod Menu for your Minecraft version. 
 
 
  incompatible with cinematiczoom  
 Keep only one Cinematic Zoom jar in  mods . 
 
 
 Crash on launch 
 Check Java: 17, 21, or 25, depending on Minecraft. 
 
 
 Settings screen missing 
 Install both Mod Menu and Cloth Config. 
 
 
 Zoom key does nothing 
 Bind  Cinematic Zoom  under Controls. 
 
 
 Wheel does not zoom 
 Enable  Mouse wheel during zoom  and hold the zoom key. 
 
 
 Bars do not appear 
 Use the cinematic key and set the bar height above 0. 
 
 
 Broken config 
 Delete  config/cinematiczoom.json  and relaunch. 
 
 
  
 Logs are in  .minecraft/logs/latest.log . Include the log and your Minecraft, mod, and loader versions when you report an issue. 
 Limits 
 
  Original Cinematic Zoom:  not compatible. Only one build can be installed. 
  Other zoom mods:  may conflict with FOV handling. Don't run them together. Import their settings instead. 
  Sodium, Iris, and shaders:  no known conflicts, but not specifically tested. 
  Quilt:  tested with the actual loader on every Fabric version. See the  verification report . 
  Forge and NeoForge:  each jar loads only on its exact Minecraft version. 
  OptiFine:  unsupported.

title: Changelog
text:
Changelog  All notable changes to Cinematic Zoom Extended are documented here. This project follows  Semantic Versioning . 
 [Unreleased] 
 [1.1.0] - 2026-11-04 
 Added 
 
 Forge and NeoForge: native builds for 1.20.1, 1.21.1, 1.21.5, 1.21.7, 1.21.11, 26.1, 26.2, and 26.3, plus NeoForge 1.21.2. Forge published no 1.21.2 loader. Each jar loads only on its exact Minecraft version. 
 Aspect ratio profiles: Auto, 2.39:1, 2.35:1, 2:1, 1.85:1, 16:9, 16:10, 4:3, and 1:1, plus custom ratios. Ratios wider than the window add top and bottom bars. Narrower ratios add side bars. 
 Profile cycling:  ←  and  →  switch ratios during cinematic zoom. Enable global cycling to switch outside zoom. The selection is saved. 
 Bar animation: entry, exit, and profile changes each have their own Instant, Linear, or Smooth mode and duration. 
 Accurate magnification up to 500× for new installations. 
 Forge settings: a built-in settings screen on 1.21.1 and newer, with no Cloth Config or Mod Menu needed. 
 
 Changed 
 
 Zoom without bars: bind it to  V  by default. Players who already set this key keep their choice. 
 Jar names: Fabric jars now include the loader, such as  cinematic-zoom-extended-1.21.2-1.21.4-fabric-1.1.0.jar . 
 26.2: this jar now covers 26.2 only. 26.2.1 and 26.2.2 have no Fabric builds to test against. 
 Existing settings: saved configs keep their FOV behavior, percentage bars, and zoom limits. Migration writes  cinematiczoom.json.v1.bak  first. 
 Repository: use  cinematic-zoom-extended  for GitHub, the Gradle project, and new build filenames. Existing release downloads, mod identity, key binds, and saved settings keep their names and contents. 
 CurseForge publishing: read the version and artifact prefix from  gradle.properties , and upload every loader. 
 
 Documentation 
 
 Update source, issue, release, and badge links to the renamed repository. 
 Wiki: interactive and animated zoom views, run on the mod's zoom code over the game's title screen panorama. Add left and right aspect presets and letterbox and pillarbox visuals. 
 Add the CurseForge release sheet, configuration defaults, and repository instructions using the shared templates standard. 
 
 [1.0.0] - 2026-10-20 
 First release, based on Cinematic Zoom 1.3 by Mel1x. 
 Added 
 
 Cinematic (bars) and Regular (no bars) zoom profiles with separate keys, zoom, timing, curves, toggle mode, snap targets, and HUD settings. 
 Per-frame smoothing with six easing curves. 
 Live arrow-key bar adjustment, ultra-wide zoom, discrete wheel steps, and snap/magnetize targets ( 2x ,  45fov ). 
 Sensitivity scaling, view-bobbing removal, and independent HUD/crosshair/hands hiding. 
 512×512 Extended icon. 
 First-run import from Zoomify, Ok Zoomer, Just Zoom, and other zoom-named configs. 
 Config migration from Cinematic Zoom 1.3. 
 40 headless regression checks. 
 
 Changed 
 
 New mod ID  cinematiczoom_extended  and name  Cinematic Zoom Extended ; original  cinematiczoom  declared incompatible. 
 Cloth Config and Mod Menu are now required. 
 Fixed Fabric API and Cloth Config declarations on 26.x. 
 Version now comes from  gradle.properties ; JARs use  cinematiczoom-extended-<minecraft>-<version>.jar . 
 Updated metadata, links, translations, and credits. 
 
 Fixed 
 
 Profile switching preserves the current zoom. 
 HUD, crosshair, and hands hide independently. 
 26.x builds no longer rely on undeclared runtime dependencies. 
 Unix  gradlew  wrapper is executable.

title: Develop
text:
Develop 
 See  multi-loader development  for native builds, pinned dependencies, and real-client tests. 
 Requires JDK 25. 1.20.1 compiles with  --release 17 , and 1.21.x with 21. 
  ./gradlew clean test buildAll
  
 This runs the headless regression suite and builds every target. Jars land in  build/libs/ . To build one target: 
  ./gradlew -PonlyTarget=1.21.7 :1.21.7:build
  
 To add a Minecraft target, add it to  minecraftTargets  in  build.gradle  and  targets  in  settings.gradle , then put its version-specific code under  versions/<mc>/ . Shared code stays in  src/common/java ; the existing legacy and modern source sets handle API differences across targets. 
 The repository and new artifact prefix are  cinematic-zoom-extended . The mod ID stays  cinematiczoom_extended , the Java package and asset namespace stay  mix.cinematiczoom  and  cinematiczoom , and settings stay in  config/cinematiczoom.json . Existing key binds and settings carry over without migration. The 1.0.0 tag and published downloads keep their original names and contents. 
 Release settings and listing copy live in  MODRINTH.md  and  CURSEFORGE.md .
